subject.title: Replacement for accidentally closed #3102: ClawScan backend error persists despite clean VirusTotal

question: Should this artifact receive a full ClawScan requeue, or may its stored result be repaired after production logs prove adjudication completed and only write-back failed?
rationale: Choosing between replay and direct state repair controls the integrity of a published security verdict and requires production evidence unavailable in the issue thread.

options.title: Requeue full adjudication
options.body: Validate the artifact hash and replay every required ClawScan stage, writing back only the new terminal result with captured worker evidence.

options.title: Repair proven persistence failure
options.body: If production logs prove all required adjudication completed successfully, atomically restore the omitted result with an audit record instead of rescanning.

recommendation.title: Requeue full adjudication
recommendation.body: Validate the artifact hash and replay every required ClawScan stage, writing back only the new terminal result with captured worker evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person was explicitly routed into the source-reproduction triage and is the strongest available follow-up contact.
